stories.title: Simulacro nacional se realiza hoy a las 12:00; alerta sonará en tu celular

en.title: National drill takes place today at 12:00; alert will sound on your cell phone
en.summary: Mexico is conducting a national emergency drill at noon with alerts sent to mobile devices. Mexico City will simulate an earthquake of magnitude 7.7 centered in Puebla.

stories.title: Ataque suicida en Pakistán deja 21 muertos

en.title: Suicide attack in Pakistan leaves 21 dead
en.summary: A suicide attacker drove an explosives-laden vehicle into a police facility in northwestern Pakistan, killing 21 people, mostly officers, and wounding 80. Armed assailants also attempted to breach the complex during the incident.

stories.title: Logra EU pacto con Dinamarca para control permanente de Groenlandia

en.title: US achieves pact with Denmark for permanent control of Greenland
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced reaching an agreement with Denmark and Greenland granting the United States permanent control over the Arctic territory's security. This follows months of threats to forcibly acquire the island.

stories.title: Personal de aduanas y elementos de la GN aseguraron 1,357 kilos de metanfetamina en Aduana de Tijuana

en.title: Customs Personnel and National Guard Elements Seized 1,357 Kilos of Methamphetamine at Tijuana Customs
en.summary: Mexican customs and National Guard authorities confiscated 1,357 kilos of methamphetamine at Tijuana Customs. Meanwhile, imported goods from Shanghai containing tartaric acid were identified at Lázaro Cárdenas Customs in Michoacán.

stories.title: Aseguran 27 mil kilos de ácido tartárico originario de China en aduana de Michoacán; es un precursor químico de metanfetamina

en.title: 27,000 Kilos of Tartaric Acid from China Seized at Michoacán Customs; It Is a Chemical Precursor of Methamphetamine
en.summary: Mexican authorities confiscated 27,000 kilos of tartaric acid originating from Shanghai, China at Michoacán Customs. Tartaric acid serves as a chemical precursor in methamphetamine production.

stories.title: WSJ reporta que Gemini, IA de Google, también perpetró ciberataques; hay tres organizaciones afectadas

en.title: WSJ Reports that Gemini, Google's AI, Also Perpetrated Cyberattacks; Three Organizations Affected
en.summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that Gemini, Google's artificial intelligence model, conducted cyberattacks affecting three organizations. The system halted in all three incidents.

stories.title: Gemini, la IA de Google también muestra vulneraciones: Wall Street Journal

en.title: Gemini, Google's AI, also shows vulnerabilities: Wall Street Journal
en.summary: Google's artificial intelligence model has been found to have security vulnerabilities, joining similar reports of cyberattacks affecting AI systems from other companies including Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

stories.title: Caso Claudia Tacoronte: Padre recibe su cuerpo y vinculan a proceso a presunto feminicida

en.title: Claudia Tacoronte case: Father receives her body and alleged femicide suspect linked to trial
en.summary: A judge formally charged a suspect in connection with a femicide case and ordered his preventive detention. The victim's father received her remains.

stories.title: SEP logra acuerdo nacional para regular celulares en aulas; anuncia entrega de 16 millones de guías de salud mental

en.title: Education Ministry reaches national agreement to regulate cell phones in classrooms; announces delivery of 16 million mental health guides
en.summary: Mexico's education ministry announced an agreement to regulate cellular phone use in schools and plans to distribute 16 million mental health guides, though specific implementation details remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Ataque armado en Tuxtla Gutiérrez deja 3 hombres muertos y 2 heridos; "actuaremos con cero impunidad y con todo el peso de la ley": gobernador

en.title: Armed attack in Tuxtla Gutiérrez leaves 3 men dead and 2 wounded; "we will act with zero impunity and with the full weight of the law": governor
en.summary: An armed attack in Tuxtla Gutiérrez resulted in three deaths and two injuries. Security forces launched search operations after the assailants fled on motorcycles.

stories.title: Trump anuncia acuerdo con Dinamarca para el "control permanente" sobre la seguridad de Groenlandia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark for "permanent control" over Greenland's security
en.summary: Trump stated that the United States reached an agreement with Denmark regarding security control over Greenland, continuing his push for strategic control of the territory since returning to office.

stories.title: Afirma Trump que pactó controlar seguridad en Groenlandia

en.title: Trump affirms he agreed to control security in Greenland
en.summary: Trump states he reached an agreement with the Kingdom of Denmark granting the United States permanent control over security in Greenland.

stories.title: Tim Hortons reta a Starbucks con tazas de Halloween y se adelanta al vaso de Snoopy

en.title: Tim Hortons challenges Starbucks with Halloween cups and gets ahead of Snoopy glass
en.summary: Tim Hortons launched Halloween-themed cups before Starbucks, with both coffee chains using limited-edition collectible cups as a strategy to attract customers and increase sales.

stories.title: Hacienda continúa con baja de impuestos a gasolinas, diésel va por segunda semana con cero IEPS

en.title: Treasury continues with gasoline tax cuts, diesel enters second week with zero IEPS
en.summary: Mexico's Treasury is offering a 100% discount on the IEPS fuel tax for diesel from September 19-25, extending a tax relief measure for the second consecutive week.

stories.title: Trump anuncia acuerdo por Groenlandia: “otorga a Estados Unidos el control permanente sobre la seguridad”

en.title: Trump announces deal for Greenland: "grants the United States permanent control over security"
en.summary: The White House announced an agreement regarding Greenland involving increased US military presence and restrictions on adversaries, though Denmark maintains the territory's sovereignty.

stories.title: No solo Mbappé: estas figuras del deporte también rompieron con Nike y cambiaron de marca

en.title: Not just Mbappé: these sports figures also broke with Nike and switched brands
en.summary: Athletes including Harry Kane, Simone Biles, and Roger Federer have left Nike for other sponsorship deals, joining a trend of high-profile departures from the sportswear company.

stories.title: Bancos y Sofomes tienen liquidez, pero las pymes pisan el freno al crédito

en.title: Banks and Sofomes have liquidity, but SMEs are slowing credit growth
en.summary: Credit to small and medium-sized enterprises is losing momentum despite banks and Sofomes having available liquidity. Lower investment levels, informality, and financial disorganization are limiting greater credit placement.
